dct_title_s: Preliminary Satellite Derived Flood Evolution Assessment, Islamic Republic of Pakistan-22 October 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20221121PAK** Status: Overall decrease of flood waters observed​ Further action(s): continue monitoring​ Summary of findings; Evolution of Cumulative Flood Waters over I.R. of Pakistan (11-17 October 2022 Vs 14-20 November 2022):​ Between 14 and 20 November 2022 approximately 8 million people remain potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas;​ Based on satellite observations between 11 and 17 October 2022 and compared with observations between 14 and 20 November 2022 , the overall flood water extent appears to continue to decrease with approximately ~ -9,000 km² in Sindh ,-400 km² in Balochistan, and ~ +500 km² in Punjab.​
